# Synthetic Context Book

## Abstract

We compare agent systems with probability models under explicit assumptions.

## Agent systems

A large language model (LLM) is used in this example.

We define a policy as a mapping from histories to actions.

Let $T$ denote the execution horizon.

### Execution

The policy maps each history to an action. Increasing $T$ does not necessarily improve success.
